    try:
        p = json.loads(raw)
        raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
    except Exception:
        pass

start = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    json.dump({"turns": ["hi", "How about next Friday the 17th", "Friday the 14th"]}, f)
